full_list.title_en: Dominant Role of Solid Matrix and Persistent Free Radicals in Cr(VI) Reduction by Biochar

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究比较200–600°C制备的稻壳生物炭、浸出液与残余固体对Cr(VI)固定和还原的作用。400°C样品RH400还原效率最高，可将毒性较高的Cr(VI)转为毒性较低的Cr(III)；结果强调固体基质及持久自由基的作用。
full_list.abstract: Biochar has emerged as a promising material for remediating toxic hexavalent chromium (Cr(VI)), yet the distinct roles of its soluble components and solid matrix remain poorly understood. This study systematically investigated the mechanisms of Cr(VI) immobilization by rice husk biochar produced at different pyrolysis temperatures (200–600°C). The biochar pyrolyzed at 400°C (RH400) exhibits the highest Cr(VI) reduction efficiency, effectively converting Cr(VI) to less toxic Cr(III). Through comparative experiments with biochar leachate and the residual solid matrix, we demonstrate that the soluble leachate does not contribute to Cr(VI) reduction, but instead antagonizes total chromium immobilization by competing for sorption sites. In contrast, the washed solid residue (WRH400) serves as the primary active component, achieving a 2.4-fold higher total Cr immobilization capacity than pristine RH400. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) analysis identifies carbon-centered persistent free radicals (PFRs) as the key electron donors for Cr(VI) reduction. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) further reveals that this reduction process is accompanied by oxidation of the biochar matrix, with a shift of PFRs from carbon-centered to carbon/oxygen-centered species. This work conclusively identifies the biochar solid matrix and its associated PFRs as the dominant drivers for Cr(VI) reductive immobilization and suggests that pre-washing biochar can optimize its performance in environmental remediation.

full_list.title_en: Initial Conformation Governs Amyloid-β42 Dynamics and Association at a POPC Membrane-Water Interface

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究比较NMR来源的Aβ42单体构象1IYT、1Z0Q和6SZF在POPC膜-水界面的行为。采用CHARMM36m力场进行比较性200 ns全原子分子动力学模拟，发现相同环境下不同初始构象会产生显著不同的膜结合与构象演化轨迹。
full_list.abstract: The conformational heterogeneity of amyloid-β42 (Aβ42) may influence its early interactions with lipid membranes, yet the extent to which different initial structures determine subsequent membrane association remains unclear. Here, three nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) derived Aβ42 monomer structures (1IYT, 1Z0Q, and 6SZF) were examined at a 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-phosphocholine (POPC) membrane-water interface. Despite an identical environment, the monomers followed different trajectories during comparative 200-ns all-atom molecular dynamics simulations using the CHARMM36m force field. The predominantly α-helical 1IYT structure underwent substantial relaxation, with α-helical content decreasing from 78.57% to 44.77%. The 1Z0Q monomer exhibited extensive rearrangement, developing 18.45% π-helical structure. In contrast, the fibril-derived 6SZF structure remodeled toward an α-helical state, increasing from 11.90% to 41.59%. Structural evolution and membrane association were evaluated using root-mean-square deviation (RMSD), fluctuation (RMSF), radius of gyration, peptide-membrane distance, interfacial contacts, hydrogen bonding, and secondary-structure analysis. These findings demonstrate that the initial conformational state of Aβ42 strongly influences its structural response to a common lipid-water environment and emphasize the importance of starting-structure selection when modeling early amyloid-membrane interactions.

full_list.abstract_zh: 针对环氧基碳纤维上浆剂与高黏度聚碳酸酯基体不相容的问题，研究提出分子设计界面改性和层间纳米桥联相结合的多尺度协同增强策略。首先采用溶胶-凝胶表面改性剂调控碳纤维界面，并进一步引入层间纳米桥联以改善载荷传递和层间性能。
full_list.abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced thermoplastic (CFRTP) composites present a recyclable alternative to traditional thermosets, yet fully realizing their structural potential remains constrained by the chemical incompatibility between commercial epoxy-based sizing on the surface of carbon fibers and high-viscosity thermoplastic matrices such as polycarbonate (PC). To overcome this bottleneck, this study introduces a multiscale synergistic dual-reinforcement strategy that couples molecularly designed interfacial modification with strategic interlaminar nano-bridging. First, a sol-gel surface modifier was molecularly designed to replace conventional sizing. This specific design constructs a reactive polysiloxane network on the carbon fiber surface, promoting robust secondary bonding and molecular chain entanglement with the PC matrix while compensating for viscosity limitations during impregnation. Concurrently, a highly dispersed multi-walled carbon nanotube (MWCNT)/PC nanofilm was interleaved at the theoretical neutral plane, establishing a localized nano-bridging and crack-deflection defense network without altering bulk melt rheology. Integrated with automated fiber placement (AFP) prepreg manufacturing, the dual-reinforced composites (MWCNTs/MCF/PC) were systematically evaluated across varying matrix melt flow indices. Compared to unmodified CFRTP baselines, the dual-reinforced laminates demonstrated significant concurrent enhancements in ultimate tensile strength (+ 23.01%), flexural strength (+ 25.10%), and interlaminar shear strength (+ 27.18%). Fractographic morphology verified a fundamental shift in the failure mechanism from interfacial adhesive debonding to energy-dissipating cohesive matrix failure. Furthermore, thermogravimetric analysis revealed a 20.01°C elevation in the maximum degradation temperature (Tmax) due to a tortuous nano-labyrinth barrier effect that restricts volatile gas diffusion. Overall, this study establishes a comprehensive framework bridging interfacial chemistry, failure physics, and automated processing to realize high-performance, fully recyclable thermoplastic composites for advanced industrial applications.

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究实验分析1550 nm分布反馈激光器中的注入电流噪声、相对强度噪声及其互谱。通过双通道快速傅里叶变换测量计算电光噪声谱相干性，低频相关性达到0.82，并量化其对量子密钥分发和量子随机数生成的影响。
full_list.abstract: We present an experimental and analytical study of the electrical-optical noise correlation in a distributed-feedback (DFB) laser diode operating at 1550 nm. Using dual-channel fast Fourier transform (FFT) measurements, we extract the power spectral densities of the injection current noise, the relative intensity noise (RIN) and their cross-spectrum. From these, the spectral coherence CI−P (f ) is computed, revealing a strong correlation at low frequencies ( 0.82). We quantify the impact of this correlation on two quantum communication technologies. For quantum key distribution (QKD), we evaluate the information leakage and show that with standard low-noise electronics it remains negligible. For quantum random number generation (QRNG), the correlated noise can be decorrelated and exploited to increase the total entropy rate by up to 20% compared to using optical noise alone. Our methodology bridges standard noise measurements with quantum performance, providing a practical solution for certifying laser sources in secure communication.

full_list.title_en: Carbon fraction-specific microbial–mineral regulation outweighs direct calcium control in carbonate karst soils
full_list.title_zh: 碳组分特异性的微生物-矿物调控超过直接钙控制在碳酸盐岩溶土壤中的作用
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究比较西南地区石灰岩和白云岩土壤中不同有机碳组分的控制机制。结合SOC分级、微生物量与群落特征、钙地球化学及矿物性质，并利用提升回归树和偏最小二乘分析，评估微生物调控、矿物保护和钙稳定作用的相对贡献。
full_list.abstract: Purpose Carbon accumulation and persistence in karst soils is governed by interacting biological and mineral processes, yet the relative roles of microbial regulation, mineral protection, and calcium-mediated stabilization remain poorly constrained. Here, we investigated SOC pools and their fraction-specific controls across contrasting limestone and dolomite soils in southwest China.Methods We combined SOC fractionation with measurements of microbial biomass and community characteristics, calcium geochemistry, and mineral-associated properties. Boosted regression trees (BRT) and partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) were used to assess the relative importance and interconnected associations of these properties with SOC, mineral-associated organic carbon (MAOC), and particulate organic carbon (POC).Results SOC pools differed among carbonate lithologies and sites, with Puding dolomite soils exhibiting the highest SOC, MAOC, and POC concentrations alongside enhanced microbial biomass and mineral surface capacity. Microbial properties were the dominant predictors of carbon fractions, accounting for 79.1%, 62.1%, and 92.5% of BRT importance for SOC, MAOC, and POC respectively, strongest for POC. MAOC was jointly regulated by microbial and mineral properties, particularly cation exchange capacity and reactive Fe–Al phases. In contrast, calcium fractions showed no significant direct effects on carbon pools and contributed 3% or less BRT importance across all fractions.Conclusion SOC storage in carbonate karst soils is more strongly associated with fraction-specific microbial and mineral-associated pathways than with direct calcium effects. These findings highlight the value of representing POC and MAOC separately and distinguishing microbial, mineral-associated, and calcium-related pathways when conceptualizing soil C cycling in karst soils.

full_list.title_en: Cold-Alkaline Processed Enset (Ensete Ventricosum) Starch: Optimization of Gel Formation, Neutralization, and Formulation for Cosmetic and Adhesive Applications

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究针对恩赛特淀粉传统热加工能耗高的问题，采用冷碱处理优化凝胶形成、中和和配方条件。该淀粉纯度约99.24%、直链淀粉含量29%并具有B型结晶，研究旨在开发适用于化妆品和胶黏剂的节能加工路线。
full_list.abstract: Background Enset (Ensete ventricosum) is a staple food crop in Ethiopia, traditionally processed into kocho and bulla (purified starch). While enset starch possesses favorable physicochemical properties including high purity (99.24%), 29% amylose content, and B-type crystallinity, its industrial applications remain largely unexplored. Conventional starch processing requires heating, which limits community-scale production. Cold-alkaline treatment offers an energy-efficient alternative, but systematic optimization for enset starch has not been documented.Objective This study aimed to optimize cold-alkaline processing parameters for enset starch gel formation, establish precise neutralization protocols, and develop formulations for adhesive and cosmetic applications suitable for community-scale production.Methods Enset starch (bulla) was mixed with water at varying ratios (1:33 to 1:8.3 w/v) and treated with 20% sodium hydroxide solution (2–6 mL per 5 g starch) at room temperature. Gel formation time, appearance, and pH were recorded. Neutralization was performed using 4M hydrochloric acid, with pH monitored after each addition. For adhesive applications, 5% borax solution (20–50 mL/L) was added, and time-dependent adhesion was evaluated over 48 hours. For cosmetic applications, 20% salt solution (0–2 mL/100 mL) was added to modify viscosity. For hair care applications, enset gel was combined with traditionally-prepared linseed (flaxseed) gel at ratios ranging from 20:80 to 80:20 (enset:linseed). All experiments were performed in triplicate.Results Optimal gel formation occurred at 5 g starch per 100 mL water with 4 mL of 20% NaOH (0.8 mL/g starch), producing a translucent, oil-like gel within 2–5 minutes at room temperature (pH 11.98 ± 0.05). Neutralization with 4M HCl followed a precise stoichiometric ratio of 0.060 mL HCl per mL of gel (R² = 0.9998). A dramatic pH breakthrough from 11.40 to 7.02 occurred during the final 0.5 mL of acid addition per 50 mL of gel. For adhesives, 5% borax at 30–40 mL per liter produced strong, time-dependent adhesion that reached optimal strength after 24 hours. For cosmetics, 20% salt solution unexpectedly reduced viscosity in a concentration-dependent manner (0.2–0.4% salt reduced flow time by 30–65%). All optimized parameters were successfully verified at scales up to 1 liter.Conclusion Cold-alkaline processing of enset starch is a reproducible, energy-efficient method requiring no heating. The optimized parameters 1:20 starch-to-water ratio, 0.8 mL 20% NaOH per gram starch, and 0.060 mL 4M HCl per mL gel for neutralization, provide a foundation for community-scale production. These findings contribute to the valorization of enset beyond its traditional role as a food crop.

full_list.title_en: Disproportionate Contributions of Baseflow to Nitrogen and Phosphorus Export in an Agricultural Watershed of Southwest China

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究分析2015至2024年云南洱海地区弥苴河流域的日流量和月度水质数据。采用Eckhardt数字滤波、LOADEST负荷估算和XGBoost归因分离基流并评估营养盐输出，发现基流占总径流40.9%，却贡献了44.3%的总氮和55.9%的总磷输出。
full_list.abstract: Baseflow is a stable runoff component fed by groundwater, yet its contribution to nutrient export from agricultural watersheds in the Erhai Lake region remains poorly quantified. We addressed this gap by analyzing daily discharge and monthly water quality data from 2015 to 2024 in the Miju River catchment, using Eckhardt digital filtering, LOADEST load estimation, and XGBoost attribution to separate baseflow, estimate nitrogen and phosphorus fluxes, and rank their driving factors. Baseflow accounted for only 40.9% of total runoff but delivered 44.3% of total nitrogen and 55.9% of total phosphorus, revealing a disproportionate role especially for phosphorus. The importance hierarchies for both nutrients converged strikingly: total runoff ranked first as the physical carrier, followed by dryness index and cumulative water deficit as shared source-sink switches, while energy factors played secondary roles. This convergence indicates that baseflow transforms phosphorus from particulate to dissolved form, coupling its transport with nitrogen. Our findings challenge the classical view that nitrogen and phosphorus behave differently, and provide direct support for joint management of subsurface nutrient pollution in intensively farmed lake basins.

full_list.title_en: Rethinking Surface-Layer Parameterization: A Turbulence-Based Framework Without Using Similarity Functions and Its Impacts on Surface–Atmosphere Coupling

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究在WRF模型中提出一种新的近地层参数化方案，以三维湍流速度尺度e*描述湍流交换，避免显式使用长期主导大气近地层模型的Monin-Obukhov相似函数。稳定度效应被嵌入湍流速度尺度，使地表-大气通量由湍流和热力状态动态产生。
full_list.abstract: This study introduces and evaluates a new surface-layer formulation implemented in the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model in which turbulent exchange is represented using a 3D turbulence velocity scale, (:e*), thereby avoiding the explicit use of Monin–Obukhov similarity functions that have formed the basis of atmospheric surface-layer parameterizations for more than five decades. In this framework, stability dependence is embedded within the turbulence velocity scale itself, allowing surface–atmosphere exchange to emerge dynamically from the evolving turbulent and thermodynamic state of the boundary-layer. Five-day simulations over the contiguous United States during representative winter and summer periods are used to evaluate the new formulation (ESTAR) relative to a standard similarity-function-based scheme (BASE). ESTAR modifies surface–atmosphere coupling by altering turbulent transport and surface energy partitioning, producing a clear regime-dependent response. Under stable or weakly turbulent conditions, ESTAR reduces near-surface wind-speed bias by approximately 0.5–1 m s− 1 and weakens the diurnal amplitude of the wind-speed bias. During convective summer conditions, ESTAR can modify daytime sensible and latent heat fluxes by approximately 50–150 W m− 2, influencing boundary-layer growth and near-surface thermodynamic structure. Vertical profile responses are more conditional and depend on site, season, and atmospheric regime, and ESTAR–BASE differences remain small, concentrated within the lower boundary-layer. These process-level modifications propagate into moist convection, reducing excessive precipitation intensity by approximately 20–40 mm day− 1 in several regions while producing more spatially distributed rainfall patterns. Overall, the results demonstrate that surface-layer exchange can be represented without explicit similarity functions while still producing physically realistic and regime-aware turbulent exchange behavior.

full_list.title_en: When accuracy does not improve decisions: a decision-outcome validation framework for cross-regional box office forecasting

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究指出，随机划分样本上的预测精度并不一定对应更好的市场选择决策。论文提出决策结果验证框架，将预测模型置于预算约束的市场选择问题中，并采用时间滚动留出、区域外和影片外泛化协议，以Top-k收益、遗憾值和命中率进行评价。
full_list.abstract: Cross-regional box office forecasting is routinely evaluated with predictive accuracy on randomly split samples, yet the models that minimize root mean squared error are not necessarily the models that produce better market selection decisions. This paper develops a decision-outcome validation framework in which forecast models are compared through a budget-constrained market selection problem, using temporal walk-forward holdouts, region-out and film-out generalization protocols, and top-k payoff, regret and hit rate as the evaluation criteria. The framework is applied to a web-sourced panel of 14 Chinese films released between 2023 and 2025, covering 76 film market pairs and 18 overseas territories with weekly gross data. Five models are compared, including a panel model with market fixed effects, regularized regression, gradient boosting and a decision-aware ranking model. The accuracy-optimal and decision-optimal models diverge in 22 of 30 validation folds. In the temporal fold covering the 2025 releases, the decision-optimal model captures 89.3 percent of the achievable revenue share, against 88.7 percent for the accuracy-optimal model and 78.9 percent for the boosting model that the weekly accuracy rankings favored, and the payoff gap between decision-based and accuracy-based selection is 152,746. Accuracy differences between models are statistically significant in three of the four temporal folds, and the decision ranking is robust to regularization strength, tree depth and the outcome window, while stronger regularization improves accuracy but lowers decision payoff. Paired bootstrap intervals for the payoff difference between decision-based and accuracy-based selection are positive across random and film-out folds, although the small number of folds limits statistical power. A Monte Carlo study with heteroscedastic market errors shows that divergence between accuracy and decision rankings is systematic when overall accuracy is balanced, and disappears only when one model dominates on both criteria. The results imply that accuracy-oriented validation with random splits is not a neutral protocol for cross-regional forecasting, and that decision outcomes should be reported alongside conventional error metrics.

full_list.title_en: Fourier-Guided Multi-Scale Vision Transformer for Object-Independent Detection and Severity Grading of Rain-Induced Cracking in Sweet Cherry

full_list.abstract_zh: 研究开发傅里叶引导多尺度视觉Transformer模型，用于甜樱桃雨致裂果的果实级严重度分级和像素级裂纹分割。数据集包含来自4个商业品种、8个果园区块的960个果实图像，模型重点提升对果梗腔附近低对比度微裂纹的识别能力。
full_list.abstract: Rain-induced cracking is among the most damaging preharvest disorders of sweet cherry because even narrow cuticular fractures reduce fresh-market value and create entry sites for water loss and fungal infection. Conventional inspection is subjective and is least reliable for low-contrast microcracks near the pedicel cavity. This study developed a Fourier-guided multi-scale Vision Transformer (FGM-ViT) for joint fruit-level severity grading and pixel-level crack segmentation. The dataset comprised 960 individual fruit from four commercial cultivars and eight orchard blocks, imaged from four rotational views after natural rainfall exposure or controlled water-immersion challenge. Crack severity was assigned as intact, microcrack, moderate, or severe using stereomicroscopic measurements of cumulative crack length, maximum width, affected surface area, and crack location. All views of an individual fruit and all observations from the same orchard block were constrained to the same fold in a nested five-fold grouped evaluation. FGM-ViT combined a multi-scale spatial encoder with luminance-normalised Fourier residual tokens and frequency-guided cross-scale attention. The complete model achieved 93.8 ± 0.9% fruit-level accuracy, 93.7 ± 1.0% macro-F1, and 0.842 ± 0.018 Dice coefficient for crack segmentation. It exceeded the spatial-only transformer by 2.2 percentage points in accuracy and 2.2 points in macro-F1, with the largest gain observed for microcracks. Classification errors were restricted almost entirely to adjacent severity categories. Under pedicel overlap, glare, brightness shifts, and motion blur, FGM-ViT retained a 2.7–3.5-point advantage over the spatial-only model. Frequency-band occlusion indicated that mid-to-high spatial frequencies carried complementary evidence for narrow fractures, whereas spatial features remained essential for crack location and marketability interpretation. The dual-output framework provides an auditable, low-cost RGB approach for sweet-cherry sorting, cultivar screening, and rain-cracking phenotyping.
